name: gui_batch
description:
Execute a multi-step GUI macro sequence in ONE call with zero round-trip latency.
    Supports: 'focus', 'maximize', 'click', 'click_element', 'click_text', 'click_mark',
    'replace_text', 'drag', 'scroll', 'type', 'key', 'hotkey', 'wait', 'wait_text',
    'wait_change', 'screenshot', 'copy_image'.
    Optional guard_window enables Focus Guard (aborts before typing if focus left target window).
    Optional stop_on_popup halts immediately if an unexpected modal dialog appears.
